signature.name: VTask.restrictVarLeft
signature.type: {L : FirstOrder.Language} -> {α : Type u'} -> {β : Type v'} -> [DecidableEq α] -> {γ : Type u_2} -> (t : L.Term (α ⊕ γ)) -> (_f : ↥t.varFinsetLeft → β) -> L.Term (β ⊕ γ)

conventions.note: NONE_DECLARED: the function is total on all well-typed inputs with no junk-value or boundary conventions needed

facts.statement: ∀ (L : FirstOrder.Language) (α β γ M : Type*) [DecidableEq α] [L.Structure M] (t : L.Term (α ⊕ γ)) (f : t.varFinsetLeft → β) (xs : β ⊕ γ → M) (xs' : α → M), (∀ a, xs (Sum.inl (f a)) = xs' a) → (VTask.restrictVarLeft t f).realize xs = t.realize (Sum.elim xs' (xs ∘ Sum.inr))

facts.statement: ∀ (L : FirstOrder.Language) (α β M : Type*) [DecidableEq α] (γ : Type*) [L.Structure M] (t : L.Term (α ⊕ γ)) (s : Set α) (h : ↑t.varFinsetLeft ⊆ s) (v : α → M) (xs : γ → M), (VTask.restrictVarLeft t (Set.inclusion h)).realize (Sum.elim (v ∘ (↑)) xs) = t.realize (Sum.elim v xs)

provenance.note: authored by eu.anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-6; certified by the v1.2 kernel validation ladder

facts.statement: ∀ (L : FirstOrder.Language) (α γ M : Type*) [DecidableEq α] [L.Structure M] (t : L.Term (α ⊕ γ)) (s : Set α) (h : ↑t.varFinsetLeft ⊆ s) (v : α → M) (xs : γ → M), (VTask.restrictVarLeft t (Set.inclusion h)).realize (Sum.elim (v ∘ Subtype.val) xs) = t.realize (Sum.elim v xs)
